content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE PARALLEL_FIELD_IO (L55-223; header L46-47: subroutines for outputting field data in various data formats; author Michael-Angelo Y.-H. Lam 12/06/2017, L50; whole file under # if defined (PARALLEL), L53/L225). Two writers of a distributed field PHI(Mloc,Nloc). PutFileASCII (L60-157, ykchoi 06/May/2017 gather rewrite): on first call builds the runtime format string FORMAT_LEN = '(<Mglob>E16.6)' by writing pieces into the global character (L85-92, guarded by SAVEd FirstCallPutFile initialized .TRUE. L81-82); strips ghost cells into LocalPHI=PHI(Ibeg:Iend,Jbeg:Jend) (L99-100); gathers per-rank index ranges iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend to rank 0 via 4x MPI_Gather (L102-111); rank 0 places its own block into PHIGLOB(MGlob,NGlob) (L113-115) and then loops irank=1..px*py-1 (L117-139) receiving each rank's interior block with mpi_irecv+mpi_wait into a temporary xx(lenx,leny) and copying it into PHIGLOB at the gathered ranges (L119-129), while rank irank sends LocalPHI with mpi_isend+mpi_wait (L131-135); rank 0 then writes the ASCII file on unit 1, row loop J=1,NGlob,OUTPUT_RES with implied inner loop I=1,MGlob,OUTPUT_RES using FORMAT_LEN (L143-154). PutFileBinary (L161-221, comment L159-160: derived from William D. Gropp lecture slides 33, cs598-s16 lecture33.pdf): MPI-IO collective write - builds two MPI subarray types: mem_type_loc describing the local interior (sizes Mloc/Nloc, subsizes minus 2*Nghost, start index Nghost 0-based, L178-201) and file_type_glob describing where that block lands in the global file (sizes Mglob/Nglob, start iista-1/jjsta-1 0-based, L189-206); MPI_FILE_OPEN with WRONLY+CREATE (L209-211), MPI_FILE_SET_VIEW at offset 0 with file_type_glob 'native' (L173, L213), single MPI_FILE_WRITE_ALL of PHI with mem_type_loc (L216), MPI_FILE_CLOSE (L218).
entities: SUBROUTINE PutFileASCII(FILE,PHI) (L60); FILE INTENT(IN) (L63); PHI DIMENSION(Mloc,Nloc) INTENT(IN) (L64)
irank, lenx, leny, lenxy, ireq locals (L71)
SUBROUTINE PutFileBinary(FILE_NAME,PHI) (L161); FILE_NAME INTENT(IN) (L164); PHI INTENT(IN) (L165); PHITEST local (L166)

constants.name: start_index_loc
constants.value: Nghost (0-based local start, both dims L184-185)

equations.ref: per-rank block width (leny L121, lenxy L122)

equations.expr: start_index_glob(1) = iista - 1 ! 0 start index even in Fortran

io.name: ASCII field file on unit 1, rank 0 only, stride OUTPUT_RES, format FORMAT_LEN

verbatim_spans.text: ! Code derived from William D. Gropp lecture slides 33
start_index_glob(1) = iista - 1 ! 0 start index even in Fortran

unresolved: Cross-line: FORMAT_LEN is built once under the SAVEd FirstCallPutFile flag (L85-92) but FORMAT_LEN itself is the CHARACTER(LEN=16) from MODULE GLOBAL (USE GLOBAL L56); the format count field uses Mglob but the write loop strides by OUTPUT_RES (L146), so for OUTPUT_RES>1 the format repeat count exceeds the items written - harmless in Fortran but the format does not reflect the decimated width.
PHIGLOB(MGlob,NGlob) is an automatic (stack) array on every rank (L79), not just rank 0 - large-grid stack usage on all ranks; the commented alternative with ghost dimensions is at L78.
PutFileASCII derived-type/inner loop assumes iista:iiend gathered ranges tile MGlob x NGlob exactly (L114, L128); no overlap/coverage check is performed.
PutFileBinary declares PHITEST (L166) and istatus (L168) but never uses them; ierr from MPI calls is never checked in either subroutine.
PutFileBinary writes raw 'native' mpi_sp records with no header; the byte layout/global-size metadata must be known by the post-processor - external convention.
The nonblocking mpi_irecv/mpi_isend pairs are each immediately mpi_wait'ed (L125-126, L134-135), making them effectively blocking; ireq is reused across iterations.
END SUBROUTINE names use different capitalization (PutfileASCII L157, PutfileBinary L221) than the declarations (L60, L161) - legal in Fortran, purely cosmetic.
